summary: A deliberately broad customer-side markup. Every action type the planner supports appears at least once, and between them the items use every field in docx_redline.planning.agent.ACTION_FIELDS. The last three target the exhibits and the signature block -- content the reviewer could not see at all until the whole document was rendered.

action_items.rationale: Align payment terms with our standard 45-day cycle.
House style: plain 'will' over 'shall' for Provider obligations. `all` hits every occurrence.
Reduce default interest. `regex` lets the pattern escape the decimal point.
Payment must not be netted against disputed amounts.
Renewal should be affirmative, not automatic.

action_items.find: \s*\(d\) use the Services to build a competing product;
action_items.rationale: Over-broad non-compete restriction; strike the whole limb.

action_items.text: Breach Notification. Provider will notify Customer without undue delay, and in no event later than forty-eight (48) hours, after becoming aware of a confirmed security breach affecting Customer Data, and will provide a written root-cause analysis within ten (10) business days.
action_items.rationale: Tighten the notification window and add a root-cause obligation. Word-level diff marks only the changed phrases.

action_items.title: Affiliate
action_items.text: “Affiliate” means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party.
action_items.rationale: Affiliate is used but never defined. Inserting before 1.1 pushes every later definition down one.

action_items.text: All amounts are stated and payable in U.S. dollars unless the Order Form says otherwise.
action_items.title: Currency
action_items.rationale: `into_section` appends to the end of a section when no anchor clause is given.
Reservation of Rights is redundant with the licence grant; deleting it closes the numbering gap.
Governing law belongs with the term provisions. Both clause groups renumber and every cross-reference follows.
The excluded claims frame the whole liability section, so they should lead it.
Customer Data before Provider IP.
Put the exclusions next to the definition they qualify. Only the clauses that must move are moved.
Indemnification should precede the limitation of liability that carves it out.
The service levels are already set out in Exhibit B; one source of truth. The whole section and its sub-clauses go.

action_items.title: Insurance
action_items.text: Provider will maintain cyber-liability and professional-indemnity insurance of not less than $5,000,000 per occurrence throughout the Subscription Term, and will name Customer as an additional insured on request.
action_items.rationale: Standard insurance covenant is missing from the agreement.
Signature block needs a countersignature line.
Ambiguous instruction in the signature block.
Customer's block does not need a printed-name row; the signature line carries it.
Flag the governing-law jurisdiction for the deal team. Recorded as a w:rPrChange.
Make the disclaimer's operative words impossible to skim past.
Give the breach-notification clause room to breathe. Recorded as a w:pPrChange.
Promote the lead definition so it shows up in the navigation pane.

action_items.text: Confirm the cap multiple with finance before signature.
action_items.rationale: Open point for the deal team.

action_items.text: Ask whether ISO 27001 is also in scope for the current audit period.
action_items.rationale: A comment can anchor on a phrase instead of a clause number.

action_items.find: Annual Fees: $186,000, payable annually in advance
action_items.replace: Annual Fees: $186,000, payable quarterly in arrears
action_items.rationale: Exhibit A: align the payment cadence with clause 3.2. Unnumbered content is targeted by a unique quote, not a clause number.

action_items.find: Below 95.0% uptime: 25% service credit of monthly Fees
action_items.replace: Below 95.0% uptime: 50% service credit of monthly Fees, and Customer may terminate for convenience
action_items.rationale: Exhibit B: the tail-risk credit is too weak to change behaviour.

action_items.text: This is a summary only. Ask for the executable DPA before signature.
action_items.rationale: Exhibit C is incorporated by reference but only summarised here.

author: Redline
